ab.d: DEADLY DEMISE24.08From detonating ammo stores to corrosive innards or frenzied death throes, some targets are deadly even in defeat.This ability always takes the form **Deadly Demise X**. Each time a model with this ability is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a **deadly demise**; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of **mortal wounds** denoted by **X** (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

DEEP STRIKE24.09There are many ways by which to deploy troops to the field of battle including tunnels, teleportation devices and other esoteric means of transportation.Each time this unit makes an **ingress move** (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.
When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Legions of Excess as your Army Faction.
You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.

At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit to be this model’s quarry. Each time this model makes a melee attack that targets its quarry, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll. Each time this model’s quarry is destroyed, select one new enemy unit to be this model’s quarry.

wp.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** lash of Slaanesh; Pavane of Slaanesh; snapping claws; Soulpiercer.

ab.d:
LEADER24.22Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each **leader** and **support** unit in your army, you can select one friendly ****bodyguard**** unit that unit can **lead**. That unit will then **lead** that **bodyguard** unit for the battle and form an ****attached**** unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each **bodyguard** unit can only have one **leader** unit and one **support** unit attached to it.

If your Army Faction is Emperor’s Children, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so:

• It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
• It cannot target a unit that was the target of another units charge or attack this phase.
While this model is leading a unit, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, models in it have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one INFANTRY unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with its Agonising Energies. Until the start of your next turn, that unit is wracked with agonies. While a unit is wracked with agonies, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

wp.loadout: **This model is equipped with:** Agonising Energies; bolt pistol; force weapon.

ab.d: INFILTRATORS24.20Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike.During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

If your Army Faction is Emperor’s Children, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so:

• It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
• It cannot target a unit that was the target of another units charge or attack this phase.

At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

At the end of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit destroyed one or more enemy units that phase, the bearer’s unit takes a Leadership test. If that test is passed, you gain 1CP.

ab.name: Quicksilver Grace
ab.description: You can re-roll Advance rolls made for Emperor’s Children units from your army.

ab.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
ab.description:
Each time an Emperor’s Children unit from your army is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, select one of the abilities below. While resolving those attacks, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have that ability:

• [LETHAL HITS]
• [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

ab.name: Mechanised Murder
ab.description: Each time an Emperor’s Children model from your army makes an attack, if it is a Transport model or disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

ab.name: Daemonic Empowerment
ab.description:
• While an Emperor’s Children unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly Legions of Excess units, it is Empowered.
• While a LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units, it is Empowered.
While a unit from your army is Empowered, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [sustained hits 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, each time an attack is made with that weapon, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

LEGIONS OF EXCESS
You can include Legions of Excess units in your army, even though they do not have the EMPEROR’S CHILDREN Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:

• **Incursion:** Up to 500 pts
• **Strike Force:** Up to 1000 pts
• **Onslaught:** Up to 1500 ptsNo LEGIONS OF EXCESS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

ab.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
ab.description:
At the start of the battle round, if your WARLORD is on the battlefield, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh representing how many enemy units will be destroyed this battle round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than or equal to your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, you do not gain any Pact points this battle round and your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Emperor’s Children units from your army gain a bonus depending on how many Pact points you have gained during the battle, as shown below (these are all cumulative).

**PACT POINTS****BONUS****1+**Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a **Hit roll** of 1.**3+**Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a **Wound roll** of 1.**5+**Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] abilities.**7+**Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified **Hit roll** of 5+.

ab.name: Internal Rivalries
ab.description:
Emperor’s Children Character units from your army can ignore any or all modifiers to their Move characteristic and any or all modifiers to Advance and Charge rolls made for them.

At the start of the battle, your WARLORD’s unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. The first time in each player’s turn that an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, after resolving all of its attacks, that CHARACTER unit becomes your army’s new Favoured Champions, replacing the old one.

Each time a model in your army’s Favoured Champions unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

ab.name: Sensational Performance
ab.description:
Emperor’s Children units from your army have the following ability:

**Sensational Performance:** Each time this unit is selected to fight, if this unit made a Charge move this turn, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase:

• This unit cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
• This unit cannot target a unit that was the target of another unit’s attack this phase.
• Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons by 1.

abx.name: Master of the Pageant
abx.description: Once per battle round, when you target a Fulgrim unit from your army with the Sinuous Breach or Prideful Superiority Stratagem, you can reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

ab.name: Eager to Kill
ab.description: When a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN TERMINATOR unit is set up, that unit has +1 to charge rolls until the end of the turn.

ab.name: Frantic Focus
ab.description: When a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN BATTLELINE unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that unit’s BATTLELINE models’ attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] until the end of the turn.

ab.name: Entitled to Victory
ab.description: Friendly FLAWLESS BLADES units have Fights First

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that made a Charge move in the previous turn and destroyed one or more enemy units in the previous Fight phase.
stratagems.fx: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if they are Below Half-strength. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army (you can only select a Vehicle if it is a Walker) that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select that enemy unit as a target of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army, or up to two Emperor’s Children Dedicated Transports from your army.
stratagems.fx: For each of those TRANSPORTS wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: One Emperor’s Children unit embarked within your TRANSPORT can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.
stratagems.fx: If your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport that made a Normal move this turn.
stratagems.fx: Your EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit is treated as having made an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children Transport from your army that has one or more Tormentors units embarked within it (excluding Battle-shocked units).
stratagems.fx: Select one objective marker you control that your TRANSPORT is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.tg: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children Character unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions, or just after your army’s Favoured Champions unit destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.tg: Your army’s Favoured Champions unit.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit from your army that is not your army’s Favoured Champions makes an attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One or more Emperor’s Children Character units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.fx: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in those CHARACTER units have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Emperor’s Children Character unit becomes your army’s Favoured Champions.
stratagems.tg: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit.
stratagems.fx: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
stratagems.rs: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit this phase has shot.
stratagems.tg: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that **surge move**.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.tg: One Emperor’s Children Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.fx: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is your army’s Favoured Champions. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.tg: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit starts a charge move.
stratagems.tg: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can move through models (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models).

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly FLAWLESS BLADES unit ends a fall-back move, if that FLAWLESS BLADES unit is unengaged.
stratagems.tg: That FLAWLESS BLADES unit.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

frules.d:
If your Army Faction is Emperor’s Children, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back, but when doing so:

• It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn.
• It cannot target a unit that was the target of another units charge or attack this phase.
When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select Legions of Excess as your Army Faction.
